Outcome: Sherlock development and an authored third study through common replay/bundle plus one version-aware reader, with no model calls.
Scope: exporter at the existing Sherlock adapter; generic unit numbering and missing extras fixes; exact legacy-v2 comparison and original FilmFestival regression. No new model runs, untouched participant evaluation, release, or scientific accuracy claims.
Decision: use the existing v2 contract and new record identities; preserve v1 reader. Reject a duplicate legacy record profile. Source CSV identity, supplied unit inventory, policy names, failure details, source-derived universe and stated-answer receipt explain digest changes.
Evidence: frozen 11-participant / 1744-unit / 34-prompt identities; old saved v1 bundles; exact unit predictions and extras; third-study actual CLI replay and bundle; scoped pipeline gate, Python readers, mutation kills and independent exact-SHA review.
Paths: AgentPackets/AgentPacketCli, StudyReplay/StudyBundle, Python bundle readers and compare_sherlock, relevant tests and existing design/ADR note.
Next: finish pre-fix third-study witness, synchronize gate clone and qualify repaired behavior.
